profileNarrative.headline: I make model behaviour measurable.
profileNarrative.summary: Every number on this page comes from a named system. Twelve years of business intelligence work ground the alignment loops I design, and the evaluation harnesses I build to check them.

sourceLines: Senior Data Analyst and AI Data Quality specialist based in Abuja, Nigeria. I operate across model alignment and the data science core.
- Phase 01: Enterprise diagnostics. Automated analytical pipelines, metric governance, and executive reporting across twelve years.
- Phase 02: Analytical systems. Programmatic semantic models, advanced analytical SQL, and Power BI governance layouts.
- Phase 03: Model alignment. Preference data collection, rubric-driven scoring, and safety evaluation for production models.

The pivot is deliberate. Every alignment loop extends the measurement discipline that analytics already enforces. Annotation rubrics are data contracts. Reward signals are metrics. Evaluation suites are regression tests.
This notebook is the live surface of that pipeline. Cells execute against the compiled payload. Telemetry renders from the same JSON the deployment ships.

sourceLines: Token-level semantic fairness audits for AI-driven hiring systems. Multi-demographic parity validation matrices run as one pipeline stage. Audit output binds to the systemArchitectureDAG node biasguard.audit.

A complete RLHF pipeline for recruiting models. The reward layer supports PPO and Direct Preference Optimization behind one configuration switch. Preference pairs flow from feedbackloop.collect into feedbackloop.align.
Personalized AI pacing and coaching. Secure vector-embedded memory drives contextual sentiment appraisal loops. Memory writes resolve through the confidencecoach.memory node.
A low-level, data-aware Cross-Layer Weighted Round Robin scheduler. High-priority tracking vectors clear immediately. Generic logs defer in bounded batches. Policy decisions execute at agrimanet.wrr.

Node domain mapping. analytics covers datasets, cleaning, pandas, sql, and powerbi. quality covers rubrics and annotation review. alignment covers rlhf, dpo, and safety. memory covers vector memory. coaching covers sentiment loops. network covers the WRR scheduler. telemetry covers dpo, reward, scheduler, and bias audits.
Each edge carries a dependencyType. Preference edges describe data contracts. Metric edges describe measured gates. Control edges describe scheduling decisions.

caseProblem.healthcare_insights: Hospital records sat in spreadsheets. Nobody could compare outcomes, cost or throughput across facilities without a manual rebuild every quarter.
caseProblem.oil_gas_operations: Maintenance and production data lived in separate extracts. Downtime drivers and spend were never read side by side.
caseProblem.biasguard: Hiring models shipped without a fairness check. No one could show which protected groups a model disadvantaged, or by how much.
caseProblem.feedbackloop: Recruiting assistants were tuned by opinion. Reward signals had no reproducible pipeline behind them.
caseProblem.agrimanet_scheduler: Field telemetry competed with routine logs for the same radio capacity, so urgent tracking packets queued behind noise.

healthcare_insights: Profiled the source extracts and defined a facility-level fact table.
Modelled outcomes, cost and throughput as comparable measures with explicit denominators.
Built the dashboard with drill-down from national to facility level.
Documented the refresh path so the build repeats without manual intervention.
oil_gas_operations: Consolidated maintenance and production extracts into one star schema.
Wrote DAX measures for downtime hours, cost per barrel and schedule adherence.
Added drill-through from the executive page to the asset-level detail page.
Published a refresh schedule and a data-quality checklist for each source.
biasguard: Defined protected attribute groups and a token-level scoring pass over generated text.
Built parity metrics that compare outcome rates across every demographic slice.
Emitted a mitigation log entry for each flagged gap, with the rule that triggered it.
Covered the scoring path with tests so a regression fails the build.
feedbackloop: Collected preference pairs with reviewer agreement scoring on every comparison.
Trained the reward model, then optimised the policy with PPO and with DPO.
Tracked reward drift across successive alignment rounds.
Published a reproducible evaluation script for each round.
agrimanet_scheduler: Modelled the cross-layer queue with separate priority classes for tracking and logging traffic.
Implemented weighted round robin with a data-aware weight update per scheduling epoch.
Simulated congestion across a heterogeneous node field.
Reported fairness and latency per class for each run.

healthcare_insights: Executive reporting replaced a quarterly manual rebuild.
Facility comparisons became answerable in one view.
KPI definitions were documented once and reused across reports.
oil_gas_operations: Downtime drivers and cost were readable in the same view.
Asset-level detail became reachable from the executive summary.
Every source carries a documented refresh path and quality checklist.
biasguard: Fairness gaps are reported per attribute group instead of as a single score.
The audit runs as one pipeline stage rather than a manual review.
Mitigations are logged with the rule that triggered them.
feedbackloop: Reward training switches between PPO and DPO through one configuration value.
Preference pairs carry reviewer agreement, so low-confidence pairs are filterable.
Drift monitoring catches a reward model that stops tracking human preference.
agrimanet_scheduler: High-priority tracking vectors clear ahead of routine logs.
Generic log traffic defers in bounded batches instead of starving.
Every run reports latency and fairness per priority class.
